title: Bnpm Policy File
description: Schema for bnpm.policy.toml — organization-level security and governance policy. Enforced by the registry and client to gate dependency resolution, installation, and publishing. Policies can be inlined in bnpm.toml ([policy]) or live in a separate file.

min-slsa-level.description: Minimum SLSA attestation level required for all dependencies. Level 3+ indicates a tamper-resistant build platform. Dependencies below this level are blocked.

items.description: SPDX license identifier allowed by policy.

allow-licenses.description: List of allowed SPDX license identifiers. Dependencies with licenses outside this list are blocked. If absent, all licenses are allowed.

require-provenance.description: If true, every dependency must have a valid provenance record (logIndex + SLSA + publisher DID). Dependencies without provenance are blocked.

max-cve-severity.description: Maximum acceptable CVE severity level. Dependencies with known CVEs above this level are blocked. 'none' means zero tolerance.

version-cooldown.description: Minimum age before a newly published version can be adopted in resolution. Format: <number><unit> where unit is h (hours), d (days), w (weeks). Blunts fast-moving supply-chain worms that publish malicious versions.

review-capability-diffs.description: If true, version upgrades that change a dependency's capability requests (adds net, subprocess, new egress host) require explicit approval before the version is adopted. This is the single highest-leverage supply-chain control.

items.description: Exact package name or glob pattern to ban.

banned-packages.description: List of banned package names (exact or wildcard patterns). Any dependency matching an entry is blocked.

items.description: DID of a banned publisher identity.

banned-publishers.description: List of banned publisher DIDs. Any package published by a banned identity is blocked.

items.description: A required identity DID or OIDC issuer URL that must appear in every package's provenance chain.

required-provenance-identities.description: Required identities that must appear in the provenance chain of every dependency. Packages whose provenance doesn't include at least one of these identities are blocked.
